hero_eyebrow: Free to start · Runs in your browser · Nothing is uploaded
hero_lead: Turn tables and text in a PDF into a real, editable .xlsx spreadsheet. Everything runs locally — your file is never sent to a server.
footnote: Works best on PDFs with real text (invoices, statements, exported reports). Scanned/image-only PDFs have no text to extract.
status_done: Done — your spreadsheet is ready to download.
generic_error: Something went wrong processing that file. Please try again.
how_title: Three steps to a working spreadsheet
how_lead: No settings to configure. Drop a file, wait a few seconds, download.
step1_desc: Drag and drop, or choose from your device. Your file never leaves it.
step2_desc: itdocsy reads the text on every page and rebuilds it into rows and columns.
step3_desc: Get an .xlsx file, one sheet per page, ready to open in Excel or Sheets.
